verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows tasks being triggered imperatively from code, which returns a handle for status, cancel and retry. Queues exist only for concurrency control of task runs. Nothing shows declarative event subscriptions, inbound webhook triggers, or one event fanning out to many functions. Missing for 10: declarative event-to-workflow binding, inbound webhook/queue triggers, one-event-to-many-functions fan-out, independent corroboration.
